messages:
Elaine Yu: Hey team — opening intake for a vendor-submitted model: calypso-8b (OpenZetta). Asking for standard bring-up: smoke evals, quant experiments (4/8-bit), catalog metadata, and a short customer-facing blurb if we pass QA. cc @Sophie Li for prioritization :wave:

Mike R.: Thanks — can you drop the model card and a small prompt set? Also any red flags (license, private data)?

Elaine Yu: Model card: https://files.internal/openzetta/calypso-8b-modelcard.md. License: permissive (Apache-2). No training-data red flags flagged by intake checklist. Attached quick prompt set in the doc (20 prompts: summary, instruction-following, multi-turn).

Sophie Li: Prioritization matrix: this is request from a customer pilot (low immediate revenue) but good perf profile on long context. My take: Medium priority but schedule for next quant batch. If we see >2% regression on instruction-following vs base Llama-2-13b baseline, escalate. :eyes:

JX: Can we run a quick perf comparison? I can queue it if someone uploads the model to staging. Need artifacts: model weights + tokenizers + onnx/ggml if available.

Elaine Yu: Uploading weights to staging in a few. Will add an artifact link here when done.

deploy-bot: release-checklist created: RH-4621 (calypso-8b). Assigned to: JX, Mike R., Sophie Li. Status: intake -> smoke -> quant -> catalog -> announce.

Mike R.: Proposed checklist (short):
```
- smoke_run: small evalsuite (50 prompts) -> pass if >90% basic completion
- quant_matrix: 8-bit, 6-bit w/ qkv reordering -> compare ppl & instruction accuracy
- latency_target: <120ms @ 8k context (p50) on A100-dedicated pool
- quality_gate: no >3% drop in ranking on evalsuite benchmark vs current 13b baseline
- catalog_meta: size, FLOPs, supported kernels, known-issues
- customer_blurb: 2-sentence safe summary
```

Sophie Li: I added it to the prioritization board and queued for the Thursday quant run. If JX can run the smoke test by EOD Wednesday we can make the Thursday slot.

JX: Running smoke now. Quick log: `./evalsuite run --model calypso-8b --suite instruction-50 --out /tmp/calypso-smoke.json`

JX: Smoke results: p(complete)=0.92, avg_toks=42, fail_cases=4 (mostly hallucinations on numeric table queries). Attaching /tmp/calypso-smoke.json to RH-4621.

Mike R.: 0.92 is fine to proceed to quant. Sophie — please flag hallucination types to ML triage so we can add focused prompts to regression set.

Sophie Li: Noting hallucination cluster: table-numeric, step-wise math. I created a small eval subset (10 prompts) to track regressions. Added to evalsuite as calypso_halluc.

Elaine Yu: Thanks. For rollout/announce: if quant results look good we'll draft a small catalog entry + short announcement twig for product to review. Can someone own the catalog entry?

Mike R.: I can draft catalog metadata and perf bullets. JX can supply kernel support notes. Sophie pls review the blurb for product.

deploy-bot: RH-4621 updated: smoke PASS -> queued for quant-run (2026-03-26 02:00 UTC).

Sophie Li: Quick decision rule: if 8-bit quantized ppl delta < 1.5% and hallucination subset drop < 2%, green to catalog. Otherwise: hold and do prompt-engineering + re-eval.

Elaine Yu: Great. I'll prepare the customer communication template for the pilot and ping product. Thanks everyone :rocket:
